summary: Runs a dual-path resource lookup three times: first and last against the global path token word_5C30B4, and in between against the custom path pointer at this[1] (this+0x4) when non-null, falling back to the global byte_5EA438 when it is NULL. Always returns 1.

local_names.this[1]: custom file path pointer at this+0x4 (fallback to byte_5EA438 when NULL)
local_names.v3: resolved path pointer fed to the second lookup

operations.description: First dual-path resource lookup against the global word_5C30B4 path token
v3 = this[1]: load the custom path pointer from this+0x4
When v3 is NULL, substitute the global byte_5EA438 path pointer as the fallback
Second dual-path resource lookup against the resolved path v3 (custom or fallback)
Third dual-path resource lookup against the global word_5C30B4 path token again
Always return 1 (success) regardless of lookup outcomes
